what_happened: The first job to use the new planning stage crashed `athena go`. Athena's own plan checks read a planned path that was a directory (docs/) as if it were a file. The operator turned planning off by hand (`[job_plan] enabled = false` in athena.toml). Planned jobs would all crash until the checks accept directories. The fix will run unplanned, and planning will be turned back on afterward. No job was involved, and the event is logged as an intervention.
cause: The planning stage was enabled in config without any test or trial run on realistic plans. Its checks assumed every planned path is a file, but plans routinely name directories. An uncaught error in a stage that is only advisory takes down the whole run, and there is no fallback. The only off switch is a hand edit of the config. The fix job also has to run with planning off, so the repair depends on the broken stage being disabled.
prevention: Make the planning stage fail soft. Any error in plan checks should be caught, logged as a planning failure, and the job should continue unplanned, with a visible warning. Also add tests that run the plan checks on file paths, directory paths, missing paths and globs, and require a dry run of the stage on a realistic plan before it can be enabled by default. With both in place, a directory path would have been handled, and any other check bug would have degraded to an unplanned job instead of a crash and a manual config edit.
proposed_request: Make Athena's job-planning stage robust. (1) Fix the plan checks so a planned path that is a directory (such as docs/) is handled correctly: checks that expect a file must treat a directory as a valid scope, and must not crash. (2) Make the planning stage fail soft: if planning or its checks raise an error, record it as a planning failure with a clear warning, and run the job unplanned instead of crashing `athena go`. (3) Add tests covering file, directory, missing and glob paths in plans, plus a test showing that a forced error in the plan checks leaves the job running unplanned. (4) Once these pass, set `[job_plan] enabled = true` in athena.toml again. Acceptance: a job whose plan names docs/ completes under `athena go` with planning on, and a forced plan-check error does not stop the run.
